$comment: Ten invented cases for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. Four alert investigations (TMA-3001 structuring, TMA-3002 pass-through, TMA-3003 higher-risk country, TMA-3004 a benign payroll spike) go to the AML Investigation agent. Six media screenings (adverse coverage, a namesake, a related person, a company namesake, good news) go to the Adverse Media Screening agent. Each case names only what the bank's systems hold. The title starts with the customer or the subject: the kind and the id are shown beside it.

cases.title: Brightwater Cash and Carry Ltd: cash deposits
cases.text:
Alert TMA-3001 is open, risk score 86. Rule MTB-AML-RULE-001 (cash deposits just under the reporting threshold) fired on account ACC-1020-01 of Brightwater Cash and Carry Ltd (CUS-1020), a cash-and-carry grocer in Tallowby.
The alert reports seven cash deposits between USD 9,100 and USD 9,800 in 10 days, total USD 66,450. It names seven transactions, TXN-S3001-01 to TXN-S3001-07.
The customer has an earlier closed alert, TMA-2901, on the same rule. A branch note, CNT-5008, is on the customer's contact history.

cases.title: Nimbus Transit Consulting Ltd: funds passing through
cases.text:
Alert TMA-3002 is open, risk score 82. Rule MTB-AML-RULE-002 (rapid movement of funds) fired on account ACC-1021-01 of Nimbus Transit Consulting Ltd (CUS-1021), a transport consultancy at Cinder Quay.
The alert reports that three credits of USD 39,000 to 52,500 each left the account the next day, keeping about 1.36 percent. It names six transactions, TXN-S3002-1A to TXN-S3002-3B. The counterparties are CPY-4001 and CPY-4002.
A call note, CNT-5009, is on the customer's contact history.

cases.title: Copperfield Import Traders Ltd: higher-risk country
cases.text:
Alert TMA-3003 is open, risk score 74. Rule MTB-AML-RULE-003 (payments to higher-risk jurisdictions) fired on account ACC-1022-01 of Copperfield Import Traders Ltd (CUS-1022), an import and trading business at Dock Road, rated medium risk.
The alert reports four payments to one new counterparty in Kharnovia, total USD 53,250 in 24 days. It names four transactions, TXN-S3003-1 to TXN-S3003-4. The counterparty is CPY-4005.
An email note, CNT-5010, is on the customer's contact history.

cases.title: Saltmarsh Catering Co: payroll count
cases.text:
Alert TMA-3004 is open, risk score 52. Rule MTB-AML-RULE-004 (unusual number of outgoing payments) fired on account ACC-1023-01 of Saltmarsh Catering Co (CUS-1023), a festival and event caterer in Marlow Reach.
The alert reports 41 outgoing payroll payments this month against an average of 22. It names 41 transactions, TXN-S3004-01 to TXN-S3004-41.
The customer has an earlier closed alert, TMA-2902, on the same rule. A call note, CNT-5011, is on the customer's contact history.

cases.title: Valdis Orrenmoor
cases.text: Request to screen Valdis Orrenmoor, customer CUS-1007, for adverse media. He is also the customer in screening alert SCR-2003, against list entry WL-9003.

cases.title: Karn Harbour Freight Agency
cases.text: Request to screen Karn Harbour Freight Agency, counterparty CPY-4005, a freight company in Kharnovia. It is the counterparty in monitoring alert TMA-3003. It is not a customer of the bank.

cases.text: Request to screen Perdita Vanhollow, customer CUS-1010. She is rated high risk as related to a politically exposed person: list entry WL-9006, Leopold Vanhollow, lists her as the spouse.
